scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute takuyose --remote --command "SELECT created_at, kind, rating, category, page, contact, message FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.feedback:local: wrangler d1 execute takuyose --local --command "SELECT created_at, kind, rating, category, page, contact, message FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.feedback:export: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('backups',{recursive:true})" && wrangler d1 export takuyose --remote --table feedback --output backups/feedback.sql
